name: Děčany (Czechia)
description: Five horizontal stripes of white, green, yellow, green and white in the ratio 1:1:1:1:1.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 13 October 2023 (decision No. 65) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
